description: Process personal data lawfully, fairly, and transparently.
Collect for specified, explicit, legitimate purposes.
Limit data to what is necessary.
Keep personal data accurate and up to date.
Retain only as long as necessary.
Appropriate security of personal data.
Demonstrate compliance with GDPR principles.
Document lawful basis for each processing activity.
Freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous; easy to withdraw.
Verify parental consent for children under 16 (or local age).
Apply enhanced protections and explicit consent/exception.
Restrict processing to lawful authority.
Provide concise, intelligible privacy info; respond to rights within one month.

requirement: Information when data collected from subject
description: Provide notice at point of collection.

requirement: Information when data not from subject
description: Notify subjects within one month if data obtained indirectly.
Provide copy of personal data on request.
Allow correction of inaccurate data.

requirement: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)
description: Delete personal data on valid request.
Restrict processing on request.
Notify recipients of changes.
Provide data in structured machine-readable format.
Honor objections, including marketing opt-out.
Provide human review for solely automated decisions with legal effect.
Implement appropriate technical & org measures.

requirement: Data protection by design and by default
description: Embed privacy in system design; default to minimum data.
Document responsibilities between joint controllers.
Appoint EU/UK representative if applicable.
Use written DPAs with processors meeting Art.28 requirements.
Maintain ROPA for controllers and processors.
Implement encryption, resilience, testing, etc.
Notify SA within 72 hours of breach awareness.
Notify subjects when high risk.
Conduct DPIA for high-risk processing.
Consult SA when DPIA shows residual high risk.
Appoint DPO when required.
Ensure DPO independence and resources.
DPO advises, monitors, trains, liaises with SA.
Ensure adequate protection for international transfers.
Verify destination has adequacy.
Use SCCs/BCRs where adequacy absent.
Maintain BCRs if used intra-group.
Document use of derogations.
Annual privacy training for all staff.
Assess processors before engagement.
Obtain consent for non-essential cookies.
Capture opt-in and provide easy opt-out.
